text: "If you want to start funding your open-source projects, don't wait until the code is perfect. The best beginner habit is to document your progress weekly. Share what you’ve built, the technical hurdles you faced, and what you’re working on next. When people see the effort and transparency behind the scenes, they are much more likely to support you financially. Consistency builds trust, and trust is the foundation of any sustainable funding model."
